items.difficulty_reason: 69 行、五条等价条件的标准证明。前四条之间的等价是短推理（derived Hom 的定义、perfect ⇒ pseudo-coherent、张量积与直接像保持伪凝聚）；真正的技术核心是把 (5)⇒(1) 化到代数：用 P^n 的生成元 P 与代数 R 建立 D(R) ≅ D_QCoh(O_{P^n})，把 K 写成 M ⊗ P，再用「RHom(R,M) = RHom(P,K)」与 (5) 说明该 derived Hom 伪凝聚，最后由「沿该等价伪凝聚可下降」得到 M、从而 K 伪凝聚。承重步骤（化到代数、derived Hom 识别、下降）都在 span 内；8 处引用（4 同章、4 跨章含 Differential Graded Algebra 三条）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-pseudo-coherent-on-projective-space (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 8772-8792

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the standard equivalences among the five conditions, the direct image computation reducing to the projective space generator, and the descent through the equivalence with the category of modules over the projective space algebra that recovers pseudo-coherence of the original complex (source lines 8794-8862)
